root_cause: Missing Level 2/3 commercial data caused the transactions to be downgraded, resulting in fee mis‑calculation.
diagnosis: The RuPay debit commercial transactions were processed without L2/L3 details, so the acquirer applied an incorrect (lower) fee versus the expected interchange‑plus rate.
action_rationale: Providing the required L2/L3 data will align the interchange rates with the expected fees and stop the discrepancy.
